messages:
maria: Heads up — new hire's onboarding sample app fails when they import the npm SDK in Cloudflare Workers. Repro in the onboarding repo, link incoming.

devon: Can you paste the exact runtime error they see?

maria: Error from the worker: "Uncaught (in worker) TypeError: default is not a constructor". Repro snippet:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood-inference/js';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: SECRET });
```

aj: That smells like an ESM vs CJS entrypoint mismatch — workers expect ESM. Could be our published package exports point to CJS by default.

sophia: I ran into something similar on Vercel Edge. Quick check of package.json in the published tarball shows only a default exports mapping to cjs. Excerpt:
```json
{
  "main": "./dist/index.cjs.js",
  "module": "./dist/index.esm.js",
  "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    "default": "./dist/index.cjs.js"
  }
}
```

maria: Yup that's what the user gets when their bundler/resolver follows exports first. Cloudflare Workers + some bundlers don't respect the legacy "module" field reliably.

devon: The problem: "default" key inside exports is not a recognized conditional for Node/browser resolvers. We should ship conditional export mapping for import/require and include types in the exports to avoid TypeScript resolver surprises.

aj: Minimal fix I propose for package.json:
```json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
    "import": "./dist/index.esm.js",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs.js"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
This gives Node and bundlers the right signals.

sophia: Also consider adding a dedicated subpath for the edge/worker build if we want to ship a slim ESM-only bundle (e.g. "./edge": "./dist/index.edge.mjs"). Some bundlers prefer a browser/worker conditional too.

maria: New hire blocked by this in the onboarding checklist — it breaks their first-run experience. Can we patch a point release? :slightly_frowning_face:

devon: I'll open a PR today with the exports change + add a smoke test that runs the sample against Cloudflare Workers (esbuild bundle) in CI. Will also add a note in the release notes about ESM/CJS compatibility. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: buildkite: #2345 passed (unit tests) — current pipeline doesn't run any worker smoke tests yet.

aj: Also add a TypeScript hint: some TS versions need "types" inside exports or typesVersions fallback. Add a small typesVersions entry so older TS resolves the declaration file.

sophia: If we add the edge subpath, make sure the SDK's bundler script outputs a tiny ESM-only artifact without optional node deps (fs, child_process) stripped.

maria: Thanks. Please link PR here when ready — onboarding doc owner will test the patch against the sample app.

devon: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/678 — includes package.json change, CI smoke test, and a short note in docs. Can reviewers please triage?
